lastCompletedStory.title: Add ARG BUN_VERSION/NODE_VERSION literal defaults to the worker Dockerfile

openQuestions: All PRD user stories (US-001..US-008, US-R3-001) now have passes:true; no non-operator stories remain. The review cycle (prd.review, currently roundsCompleted:2/maxRounds:3, lastVerdict:null) should now run to a terminal verdict via the sidecar for this round; nothing further to implement unless review produces additional FIXES_PENDING follow-up stories.

The `docker build --call check` no-warning outcome for InvalidDefaultArgInFrom is meant to be host-verified by the orchestrator post-implement per the story notes (no docker daemon available in this worker sandbox to run it directly); the machine gate (the two grep oracles on the literal ARG default lines) passed cleanly and was step-5.5-validated against Docker's own build-checks docs (see officialDocsValidated below).

Per the story's own DESIGN DECISION text, US-003 AC#3 (a drift test) and US-008 AC#2/#4 (Renovate customManagers keeping the Dockerfile ARG default in lockstep with the pin files) are intentionally NOT implemented (retired as redundant given the reader-only toolchain feed via buildDockerBuildArgv). Confirmed renovate.json customManagers stays empty and test/toolchain-parity.test.ts was not created, matching AC#3's file-assert oracle.

Observed one non-reproducible `bun test` failure (1 fail / 3603 pass) on the very first post-edit run, then 0 fail across 35+ subsequent repeat runs (including the final bun run check:all gate run). This story only touched .devcontainer/Dockerfile (no test in the repo references the ARG lines, confirmed via grep), so the change surface cannot explain a test regression. This matches the ALREADY-DOCUMENTED flake class in patterns.md (CAM-201, 'bunfig.toml [test].timeout is silently ignored on bun 1.2.23' bullet and the terminal-size/tput subprocess-stall bullet above it): real-subprocess/tput-shellout stalls under full-suite CPU contention. Not a new pattern, not blocking; recorded here per the no-flaky-evasion documentation requirement, not as an open defect.
nextStoryContext: This was the final non-operator story in the current review round (US-001 through US-008 plus the review-filed follow-up US-R3-001 all pass now). If prd.review produces further FIXES_PENDING stories, implement those next. If nothing further is filed, no additional implementation work is expected from this PRD.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed via WebSearch against docs.docker.com that InvalidDefaultArgInFrom fires when an ARG referenced in a FROM instruction lacks a default that resolves to a valid image reference without --build-arg, and that the documented fix is to declare the ARG with a literal default BEFORE the first FROM (exactly the pre-FROM `ARG BUN_VERSION=1.3.13` shape this story implements). No code change needed as a result of this check; the implementation already matched the documented fix pattern.
